summary: Iteration 313 backend verification for audit fixes T-01..T-11. Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter313_audit_fixes.py with 17 tests — all PASS. Also ran both ready-made probes: T-01 (iter313_t01_resolve_escalation_probe.py) → PASS, T-09 (iter313_t09_reorder_lifecycle_probe.py) → PASS. No regressions found on touched endpoints.

minor.issue: Kubernetes ingress rewrites Set-Cookie for the preview URL adding 'Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned', overriding app-level SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=false / SameSite=lax. Verified by calling backend directly on http://localhost:8001 where the cookie is correct: 'HttpOnly; Max-Age=86400; Path=/; SameSite=lax' (no Secure). App fix is correct; the mismatch is infrastructure-level only.

Ingress overrides Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' for OPTIONS preflight, so strict allow-list cannot be observed from the public URL. Direct call to http://localhost:8001 confirms the app returns ACAO only for the whitelisted origin and 400 (no ACAO) for evil.example. App fix works correctly.

action_items: None required for the audit fixes themselves; all T-01..T-11 checks succeed at the application layer.

Optional/informational: document in /app/memory that the k8s preview ingress mutates Set-Cookie (adds Secure/SameSite=None/Partitioned) and forces Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on preflight. Any future T-02-style checks against the public URL must be run against http://localhost:8001 to observe application-level behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: Ordering of AR-Receipts guards is fine but note: the entity-scope guard fires before the RBAC dependency when X-Entity-Id=all. If audit intent is 'RBAC first for writes', consider swapping order. Current behaviour: with a concrete entity (ent_ksc) warehouse → 403 (ar_receipt.create), finance → 422; this matches T-10.
sales_orders_extra.approve_order idempotency verified: repeating approve on an already-approved SO returns 200 with status=approved; done/shipped/confirmed → 409 INVALID_TRANSITION.
purchase_requisition_service.reorder_suggestions correctly emits 'lifecycle' and 'lifecycle_warning' on every item across block/warn/off modes (probe passes).
